findings.key_quote: Gross margin decreased 100 basis points to 50.2% of net sales. The decrease in gross margin was due to: • 120 basis points of decline from unfavorable product mix
findings.justification: This evidence is for fiscal 2026 (period ending 2026-06-30, 12 months, EXACT_MATCH). It states that gross margin decreased 100 basis points total, and breaks down the causes. Unfavorable product mix contributed 120 basis points of decline, which is the largest single factor among all the listed causes (product/packaging investments 70 bps, restructuring 60 bps, tariffs 30 bps, commodity costs 20 bps, etc.). This directly entails that unfavorable product mix was the largest single factor behind the gross margin decline in fiscal 2026.

findings.key_quote: The gross margin decrease of 140 basis points was driven by unfavorable product mix and higher commodity costs, partially offset by productivity savings.
findings.justification: This evidence is for the Home Care segment only, not for P&G overall. While it mentions unfavorable product mix as a driver of gross margin decline, it does not provide a breakdown of the magnitude of each factor, so we cannot determine if product mix was the largest single factor. It is on topic but does not settle the assertion about the company-wide gross margin.

findings.key_quote: Gross margin decreased 150 basis points to 49.5% of net sales for the quarter. The decrease in gross margin was due to: • 180 basis points of decline from unfavorable product mix
findings.justification: This evidence is for a 3-month period ending 2026-03-31 (period_status: MISMATCH), not the full fiscal year 2026. While it shows unfavorable product mix as the largest factor (180 bps) for that quarter, it does not decide the assertion about the full fiscal year.

findings.key_quote: The primary drivers of changes in gross margin are input costs (energy and other commodities), pricing impacts, geographic mix (for example, gross margins in North America are generally higher than the Company average for similar products), product mix
findings.justification: This provides general context about what drives gross margin changes at P&G, including product mix. However, it does not provide specific information about fiscal 2026 results or the relative magnitude of these factors in that period.
